versions.changelog: Full bilingual SKILL.md: complete English documentation first, then complete Chinese documentation. Corrected stale counts (46 toolboxes / 2500+ tools / server v2.1).
Bilingual (English + Chinese) skill description for global discoverability; description counts corrected to 46 toolboxes.

Expanded toolbox coverage: 32 additional arcpy toolboxes (ia Image Analyst, geoai deep learning, md multidimensional rasters, un/nd/tn utility network, parcel, ba, defense/topographic/aviation/maritime, lr/locref, ca, td and more) - now 47 modules / 2500+ tools, census-verified on ArcGIS Pro 3.x. New grouped module cheat-sheet in SKILL.md.
Initial release: wrap arcpy-mcp-server v2.0 (1300+ ArcGIS Pro tools) as an agent skill with HTTP API usage guide, module reference and security whitelist (env-configurable ARCPY_ALLOWED_PATHS).
